text:
anya: thinking about a new console widget for cost -> a per-token "sensitivity" heatmap that shows marginal cost impact by token position + cache-hit probability per model. idea is to help routing UX pick cheaper variants for low-sensitivity prefixes and show where cache saves actually came from. thoughts?

pj: sounds useful. main worry: telemetry cardinality. per-token metrics explode quickly. how do you envision sampling or aggregating? :thinking_face:

anya: agree on cardinality. proposal: bucket token positions (1,2-8,9-32,33-128,>128) and show percentile bands per model + promptshape. we only surface the buckets in the UI, but store raw histograms at 1% sample for 7 days for debugging. keeps primary dashboard small.

mike: sampling 1% might still add a lot. rough calc: 100k reqs/min * avg 60 tokens * 0.01 = 60k token events/min -> signals pipeline impact. can we derive cache-hit prob from existing kv-warmup traces instead of emitting per-token events?

elaine: from an ML perspective, having position buckets + model variant is enough. also add a "sensitivity score" that's a weighted average of token marginal loss if we quantize or route to smaller model. that score can be precomputed offline for each promptshape.

dan: two product asks: 1) show expected cost delta if route 10%/50%/100% to fallback model; 2) show who gets credited for cache savings (tenant vs shared prefetch). both are must-haves for billing teams.

pj: for rollout: we should launch behind an opt-in feature flag and only for routes with > 1k qps to avoid noise. also add a server-side aggregation job that windows per-minute and emits summarized rows to the cost-index.

mike: implementation detail: we can piggyback on the router trace and emit a single aggregated proto per request containing: model, variant, token_buckets[], cache_hits[], total_tokens, latency_ms. e.g.

```
{
  route: "/api/v1/generate",
  model: "open-ggml-13b-q4",
  token_buckets: [2, 18, 34, 10, 0],
  cache_hits: [1, 16, 29, 8, 0],
  total_tokens: 64,
  latency_ms: 220
}
```
This keeps events bounded per request.

elaine: privacy check: make sure we never store raw prefix text and only store counts. also TTL policy (7 days) is fine. add KMS tagging for private deployments.

anya: UI asks: expose a "what-if" slider (route percent) and a sparkline of projected cost + latency impact. also expose a tooltip that breaks down cache savings by model variant and promptshape.

dan: for billing accuracy, we need a reconciliation path: hourly reconciliation job that consumes sampled events and reconciles with invoiceable token counts. flag if delta > 1%.

pj: agree. ops runbook item: if sampled telemetry floods kafka, fallback to reservoir sampling at router level and emit a warning metric. also add quota guardrail: heatmap generation job gets compute budget and can be paused if it exceeds X CPU.

mike: dev work: router proto change + aggregator + cost-index schema + console chart. estimate 3 sprints (router + infra + ui). can prototype with a feature-gated shim that reuses current cost pipeline.

anya: sounds good. action items: @pj will draft infra design, @mike will prototype bounded proto shim, @elaine will define sensitivity scoring, i'll mock the UX and the dashboard copy. can we get a quick sync tomorrow?

pj: acked. i'll start a design doc this afternoon and link it here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: cost-telemetry-proxy v0.3 -> staging (CI #4523)

mike: nice, i'll watch the staging logs for proto shape changes.

anya: thanks all — keeping the initial exposure tight feels right. :rocket:
